description:
*“So you've been sharing your bed with a demon, my lady. I never imagined my wife could be so vulgar.”*

Just because she had a dream about a demon, her husband, affectionate throughout their marriage, suddenly changed in an instant. Niv endured a life treated worse than an animal, like a candle that could be snuffed out at any moment. Then Delphion appeared, like salvation in that life. Niv fell helplessly for his mysterious, languid aura, continuing her illicit affair with the demon as her body and soul became drenched in desire...

 *“Do you call the one you love your savior?”*

Therefore, to survive, she had to grasp the savior's hand. Even if it was impure.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
